definitions.explanation: A shared mail collection area in an apartment building where individual mailboxes for each unit are grouped together, typically near the entrance.

examples.japanese: {集合|しゅうごう}ポスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
{集合|しゅうごう}ポスト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: There was mail in the communal mailbox.

examples.japanese: {集合|しゅうごう}ポスト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。

notes:
{集合|しゅうごう}ポスト is standard in Japanese apartment buildings. Each unit has its own locked mailbox within the communal area, which is usually located near the building entrance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合|しゅうごう}ポスト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧ (mailbox key)
- {集合|しゅうごう}ポスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open the mailbox)
- {集合|しゅうごう}ポスト⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧ (mailbox area)
